gloss: dire financial straits; desperate money trouble

definitions.gloss: dire financial straits; desperate money trouble
definitions.explanation: A household or organization whose finances are so strained that it can barely meet its obligations. Nearly always used in the pattern {家計|かけい}は{火|ひ}の{車|くるま}だ.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{火|ひ}の{車|くるま}だ。
examples.english: Our household finances are in dire straits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{火|ひ}の{車|くるま}になった。
examples.english: Sales fell and the company ended up in serious financial trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{内情|ないじょう}→内情：25305_naijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{火|ひ}の{車|くるま}で、⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支払|しはら}い⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{遅|おく}れている→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: It looks impressive from outside, but internally the finances are desperate and even salaries are being paid late.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From {火車|かしゃ}, the blazing cart of Buddhist hell said to carry sinners away — hence a state of torment, narrowed in modern use to financial torment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{火|ひ}の{車|くるま}: the household budget is in crisis
- ⟦{内情|ないじょう}→内情：25305_naijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{火|ひ}の{車|くるま}: the real finances are desperate
- {火|ひ}の{車|くるま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to fall into dire straits

USAGE:
Restricted to money. A schedule or workload that is desperately tight is not {火|ひ}の{車|くるま} but ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{回|まわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ or simply ⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧.
